_comment: Reviewed by a person. Groups the register's organisation types into sectors for the Sector filter, and corrects the sector of an organisation whose type does not say what it is: the register files universities, charities, public bodies and companies alike as "Research". A correction is by organisation page slug and applies to every agreement the organisation holds. See pipeline/sectors.py.
